day_local: Khamiis ee Usbuuca Afraad iyo Labaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Rabbigeenna Yesu Masiix ha idinla joogaan.
penitential:
Rabbiyoow, naxariiso.
Masiixoow, naxariiso.
Rabbiyoow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: U mahadnaqa Rabbiga, waayo waa wanaagsan yahay; naxariistiisu waa mid waarta.
homily:
Bal qiyaas adigoo taagan garoonka diyaaradaha, adigoo daawanaya diyaaradaha waaweyn ee kor u kacaya cirka buluugga ah. Halkaas ayuu Benjamin Vo inta badan joogi jiray. Indhihiisu waxay ka buuxaan raynrayn iyo su'aalo aan dhammaad lahayn. Wuxuu si qosol leh uga hadli jiray shirkaddiisa diyaaradaha ee uu rabay inuu abuuro oo uu ugu magac daray 'Con Chim Airlines'. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo eego hawada sare, sida loo fahmo mishiinnada, iyo sida loo dhiso koodhka kumbuyuutarka isagoo da' yar. Wuxuu qof walba la wadaagi jiray dhoolacaddayn fudud oo aan khiyaano lahayn. Laakiin maanta, adduunku wuxuu leeyahay aamusnaan kale, guriguna wuxuu dareemayaa culeys saddex bilood kadib markii Ben u aaday Jannada June 13, 2026.

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, Bawlos wuxuu kagusoo celinayaa inuu dadka xusuusiyo Injiiilka uu u wacdiyay: 'In Masiixu u dhintay dembiyadayada siday Qorniinku qabo, in la aasay, in la sara kiyay maalinta saddexaad.' Bal joogso hal daqiiqad oo ku fiirso ereyadan. Bawlos ma hadlayo fikrad fog. Wuxuu ka hadlayaa xaqiiqo ah in dhimashadu aanay ahayn dhamaadka sheekada. Sida Ben u jeclaa inuu arko diyaaradaha oo ka duulaya dhulka oo gaaraya meel fog, xaqiiqada sarakiciddu waxay inoo sheegaysaa in nolosheennu ay leedahay meel ka sarraysa dhibaatada iyo xanuunka aan halkan ku aragno.

Injiilka maanta ee Luukas wuxuu ina geynayaa guri kale, guri uu Farisiisku ku casuumay Ciise. Laakiin waxaa soo galaysa haweenay loo aqoonsaday inay dembiile tahay. Waxay keenaysaa dhalo cadar ah, waxayna istaagaysaa cagihiisa dambe. Ilmeynteedu waxay dhaqaysaa cagaha Ciise, timahana way ku tirtiraysaa, wayna dhunkanaysaa. Farisiisku wuxuu qalbigiisa ka leeyahay: 'Haddii ninkani nebiyad lahaa, wuu garan lahaa naagtan.' Laakiin Ciise wuxuu arkaa wax ka duwan. Wuxuu arkaa qof fahmay qiimaha naxariista. Wuxuu u sheegayaa sheekada laba qof oo deyn lagu lahaa, midna wuxuu lahaa deyn weyn, midna mid yar. Kii loo caffiyay wax badan ayuu jeclaaday.

Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay idinku noqdeen kuwo dheer oo culus. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad maqashaan aamusnaanta guriga oo aad aragto sawirrada Benjamin, aad is-weydiinaysaan su'aalo culus. Waxaa laga yaabaa in cod yar uu idinku yidhaahdo gudahaaga: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn lahayn?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen—sheekooyinkii Alan, xanaanadii Thao—wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa. Sida Ben u lahaa qalbiyada deeqda ah ee mar rabay inuu bixiyo sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William, sidaas oo kale ayaad adinkuna u bixiseen jacayl buuxa.

Bal xusuuso riyadii aad aragtay, Alan, markii Ben uu kuu sheegay: 'Ba, test-ka waan ka gudbay. Con tự thở được bình thường mà…' Ben wuxuu xor ka yahay culeyskii jirka. Wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon. Wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.' 

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waxaan ogahay inaysan fududayn inaad lumiso saaxiibkaaga, walaalkaa, kii aad la wadaagaysay adduunka. Laakiin Ben wuxuu kaa doonayaa inaad sii waddo socodka, inaad noolaato adigoo geesinimo leh, adigoo xusuusanaya in xiriirka idinka dhexeeya uusan dhiman. 

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Aamiin.
petitions: Rabbiyoow, naxariiso oo naga aqbal salaaddayada.
standing_petitions: U ducee Ben iyo dhammaan inta dhimatay, inay ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiix.
U ducee dhammaan inta murugoonaysa, inay helaan xoog, raaxo, iyo rajada uu Ilaah bixiyo.
spiritual_communion: Ciisow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sakraments-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaana jeclaan lahaa inaad geliso naftayda. Maaddaama aanan hadda heli karin Sakramentaal, fadqalalo la'aan qalbigeeda ugaalay inaan kula midoobo. Weligaa ha ii oggolaanin inaan kaa fogaado.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin haysto; wajigiisa ha idinku dul iftiimiyo oo ha idin naxariisto. Nabadda Masiix ha idinla joogto weligeedba. Aamiin.

readings.label: Reading 1
readings.text:
I am reminding you, brothers and sisters,
of the Gospel I preached to you,
which you indeed received and in which you also stand.
Through it you are also being saved,
if you hold fast to the word I preached to you,
unless you believed in vain.
For I handed on to you as of first importance what I also received:
that Christ died for our sins in accordance with the Scriptures;
that he was buried;
that he was raised on the third day in accordance with the Scriptures;
that he appeared to Cephas, then to the Twelve.
After that, he appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once,
most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.
After that he appeared to James,
then to all the Apostles.
Last of all, as to one born abnormally,
he appeared to me.
For I am the least of the Apostles,
not fit to be called an Apostle,
because I persecuted the Church of God.
But by the grace of God I am what I am,
and his grace to me has not been ineffective.
Indeed, I have toiled harder than all of them;
not I, however, but the grace of God that is with me.
Therefore, whether it be I or they,
so we preach and so you believed.

readings.label: Responsorial Psalm
readings.text:
R. (1) Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good,
for his mercy endures forever.
Let the house of Israel say,
“His mercy endures forever.”
R. Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
“The right hand of the LORD is exalted;
the right hand of the Lord has struck with power.”
I shall not die, but live,
and declare the works of the LORD.
R. Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
You are my God, and I give thanks to you;
O my God, I extol you.
R. Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.

readings.label: Gospel
readings.text:
A certain Pharisee invited Jesus to dine with him,
and he entered the Pharisee’s house and reclined at table.
Now there was a sinful woman in the city
who learned that he was at table in the house of the Pharisee.
Bringing an alabaster flask of ointment,
she stood behind him at his feet weeping
and began to bathe his feet with her tears.
Then she wiped them with her hair,
kissed them, and anointed them with the ointment.
When the Pharisee who had invited him saw this he said to himself,
“If this man were a prophet,
he would know who and what sort of woman this is who is touching him,
that she is a sinner.”
Jesus said to him in reply,
“Simon, I have something to say to you.”
“Tell me, teacher,” he said.
“Two people were in debt to a certain creditor;
one owed five hundred days’ wages and the other owed fifty.
Since they were unable to repay the debt, he forgave it for both.
Which of them will love him more?”
Simon said in reply,
“The one, I suppose, whose larger debt was forgiven.”
He said to him, “You have judged rightly.”
Then he turned to the woman and said to Simon,
“Do you see this woman?
When I entered your house, you did not give me water for my feet,
but she has bathed them with her tears
and wiped them with her hair.
You did not give me a kiss,
but she has not ceased kissing my feet since the time I entered.
You did not anoint my head with oil,
but she anointed my feet with ointment.
So I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven;
hence, she has shown great love.
But the one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”
He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
The others at table said to themselves,
“Who is this who even forgives sins?”
But he said to the woman,
“Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”

day: Thursday of the Twenty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
